name: smarthome-hub
description: Control and ask about your home through your own smart home hub: devices, rooms, scenes, schedules, sprinklers, thermostats, and insights on electricity, bills, pool, HVAC and water.
long_description: Connects Claude to the hub's MCP endpoint on your tailnet. Every action the hub can take is a tool (58 in all). Signing in, passwords, API keys and account linking stay in the hub's app. Needs Tailscale on this computer and the hub's API token.

hub_url.title: Hub MCP address
hub_url.description: Your hub's address with /mcp at the end, e.g. https://your-mac.your-tailnet.ts.net/mcp

api_token.title: Hub API token
api_token.description: access_token from ~/.smarthome/secrets.json on the hub's Mac. Kept in the keychain.
